primary_evidence.finding: Confirms EUR11.662bn sales, EUR3.289bn Installed Base Management sales, 57.5% gross margin, Q4 guidance EUR14.2-15.2bn at about 57% margin, FY2026 EUR44-45bn at about 56%, and management's statement that currently planned 2027 and 2028 supply will not fully meet customer demand.

Shows material geographic/export and concentration risk: China was 29.1% of 2025 sales; Taiwan 25.5%; South Korea 25.0%; four customers individually exceeded 10% and together represented 61.2% of 2025 sales. Export controls and trade restrictions can affect customers, suppliers, shipment eligibility and demand.

Provides normalization anchor: FY2025 gross margin was 52.8%, Installed Base Management sales EUR8.193bn, and year-end backlog EUR38.797bn; backlog consists accepted system sales orders not yet recognized as sales.

restriction: G1 may state that primary disclosures support a capacity-scarcity plus installed-base-upgrade business mechanism. It may not claim durable earnings-power expansion as established, backlog conversion as assured, 57.5% gross margin as sustainable, security undervaluation, or positive alpha.
